name: test-speedup-jingle
source: The variant tool's test fixture, in no tweak list: SA2 Mod Loader Codes.lst, Patch "Disable High Speed Music" (writenop 0046E072 5)
why: 0x0046E000 (PlayerSpeedUp, the high-speed power-up's handler) takes the player's CharObj2 from 0x01DE9600 + 4 * the player number (deleting its task at 0x0046E017 when there is none), scales the three speed fields at +0xFC, +0xD0 and +0x128 by the double at 0x00904F78, calls 0x00443480 (PlayJingle) at 0x0046E072 with EBX = 0x008B94FC ("speedup.adx"), then picks a voice line by the character byte at +3 through the jump table at 0x0046E0E4. Five `nop`s in place of the call leave the jingle out; the rest of the function runs as before. The tweak no-powerup-music drops the same jingle inside its wrap of PlayJingle (by the return address 0x0046E077) and wraps no function this fixture patches.
